New public API in Bearing.Sql: enum SearchEngine{Elasticsearch,OpenSearch}; enum SearchLanguage{Sql,Piped}; enum SearchTokenKind{Word,Number,QuotedName,String,LineComment,BlockComment,Punctuation}; record SearchToken(SearchTokenKind Kind,int Start,int End /*exclusive*/,string Text,bool Terminated=true){bool IsCode}; record SearchStatement(StatementSpan Span,SearchLanguage Language,bool LanguageFromLeadWord,IReadOnlyList<string> LeadWords /*up to 2, upper-cased*/,string Verb /*first code token, upper-cased*/,IReadOnlyList<string> PipeCommands /*first word after each depth-0 '|', "" if none*/,IReadOnlyList<SearchToken> Tokens). static SearchScan: Statements(SearchEngine,string), Tokens(SearchEngine,string), Split(SearchEngine,string)->IReadOnlyList<StatementSpan>, StatementAt(SearchEngine,string,int)->SearchStatement?, InString(SearchEngine,string,int), EndsWithLineComment(SearchEngine,string), CodeEnd(SearchEngine,string)->int?, RedactLiterals(SearchEngine,string?). Internal: Describe, CommandWords, DotIndexName. ElasticsearchDialect.Instance (Id "elasticsearch", PgParseRules, double-quote names, its own keyword list for quoting) and OpenSearchDialect.Instance (Id "opensearch", MySqlParseRules, backtick names). ExternalDeniedStatement returns a whole refusal sentence ending in '.', which ExternalSqlPolicy.Refuse now returns as-is (a shape NAME still gets the credentials wrapper, so MySQL is unchanged). RULES SearchBatch (B5) MUST MIRROR — they are in the SearchScan type doc: (1) The prelude (leading whitespace, comments, lead words) is read with: on Elasticsearch --, // and nested /* */; on OpenSearch #, -- followed by whitespace or end of text, //, and non-nested /* */; strings and names by the engine's SQL rules. (2) The 'otherwise' rule reads the statement by SQL rules; a depth-0 '|' (not '||') makes it Piped, and it is then re-read by PPL / ES|QL rules. (3) A statement ends at ';' at any depth. It ALSO ends at a blank line at depth 0 before an opener word, unless the previous code token is , ( | UNION INTERSECT EXCEPT or MINUS. Elasticsearch openers: SELECT SHOW DESCRIBE EXPLAIN SYS DEBUG PROMQL. OpenSearch openers: SELECT SHOW DESCRIBE EXPLAIN DELETE SEARCH SOURCE MULTISEARCH MAKERESULTS GRAPHLOOKUP. (4) Spans follow StatementSplitter's Postgres contract (a theory pins this). On an exposed connection an unknown first word is refused by ExternalSqlPolicy as "'FOO' is not a read"; a PPL statement starting with '|' as "'|' is not a read". Dot-index refusal checks bare/quoted/backticked names across the statement, and strings only where they name the source (ES|QL FROM/TS segment; PPL source=/index= values).
